recent_years.unlock_rule: every frozen 2021-2023 development gate must pass

source.report: CFTC Traders in Financial Futures, Futures Only
source.availability: report date plus seven calendar days

source_report_direction_permutation.method: shuffle slow-state direction labels across source reports while preserving report multiplicity and the realized fast market/quote panel

controls.es_only_opening_direction: trade every nonzero five-minute ES direction
controls.cot_only_relative_transfer: trade the slow direction every eligible session
controls.one_report_shifted_transfer: replace each source report direction with the immediately preceding source report direction
controls.asset_manager_only_confirmation: five-minute ES direction equals sign of Asset Manager net change
controls.leveraged_fund_rejection: five-minute ES direction is opposite sign of Leveraged Fund net change

development_gates: more than 2.0 executed trades per 753/5 declared weeks
at least 95 percent execution coverage after degraded-session exclusions
positive UPRO and SPXU fixed-notional PnL separately
compounded ending cash above adjusted SPY
positive fixed-notional PnL after one extra cent adverse at entry and exit
positive fixed-notional PnL after a five-minute entry delay
positive PnL after deleting the five best source-report clusters
positive independent-feed overlap PnL with profit factor above one and both sleeves represented
actual mean trade PnL above the one-report-shifted and COT-only controls
prohibited_repairs: require strict category collision after seeing outcomes
remove a year, weekday, or actuator
add a stop, volatility filter, or magnitude filter
substitute a control for the candidate
